title: Conceptizer: Next-Token Prediction Is Not All You Need
abstract: arXiv:2610.33027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Next-token prediction (NTP) rewards only the token that occurs next, penalizing every alternative. But natural language often offers many ways to express the same meaning. We introduce Conceptizer, a training framework that extends next-token prediction with a reward for meaning. Conceptizer uses a fixed, model-agnostic vocabulary of ~9K concepts, built from contextual synonyms, as units of meaning alongside tokens as units of text. It maps each next-token distribution to a concept distribution and shares the reward for the target meaning across its possible wordings. This provides a concept-level training signal without adding model parameters. Applied to 3 model families at 1B-8B parameters, Conceptizer achieves the lowest held-out NTP perplexity at concept-target positions and assigns the highest probability to contextual synonyms, against all 3 baselines. translated_title: Conceptizer：下一词预测并非你所需要的全部
translated_abstract: 下一词预测（NTP）只奖励紧接着出现的那个词元，而惩罚所有其他替代选项。但自然语言往往提供多种表达同一含义的方式。我们提出了Conceptizer，这是一个通过引入对“意义”的奖励来扩展下一词预测的训练框架。Conceptizer使用一个固定的、与模型无关的、由上下文同义词构建的约9000个概念组成的词汇表，将其作为意义单元，与作为文本单元的词元并行使用。它将每个下一词元分布映射为概念分布，并把目标意义的奖励在其所有可能的措辞之间共享。这在不增加模型参数的情况下提供了概念级别的训练信号。将该框架应用于3个模型家族的1B-8B参数模型，与所有3个基线相比，Conceptizer在概念目标位置取得了最低的保留集NTP困惑度，并为上下文同义词分配了最高的概率。同时，它还提升了知识和情感类任务上的下游性能……
tldr: Conceptizer通过引入由上下文同义词构建的约9000个概念组成的固定词汇表，将下一词预测扩展为对“意义”的奖励，在不增加模型参数的情况下改善了概念目标位置的困惑度、同义词概率分配以及知识和情感类下游任务的表现。
en_tdlr: Conceptizer extends next-token prediction with a concept-level reward for meaning using a fixed, model-agnostic vocabulary of ~9K contextual-synonym concepts, achieving lower NTP perplexity at concept-target positions, higher probability for contextual synonyms, and better downstream knowledge and sentiment performance without adding parameters.
